name: telemetry-sink
description: Telemetry sink (wa:telemetry): subscribes to the bus, batches typed spans/metrics/events and hands them to the node's bounded sink, which writes rotating JSONL (default) and optionally exports OTLP/HTTP to one granted endpoint. No JSON on the bus, no message text in a record, no publishing (docs/OBSERVABILITY.md, 'The sink')
